examples.en: She stripped the bed and washed the sheets.
examples.ar: هي نزعت أغطية السرير وغسلت الملاءات.

examples.en: The wind stripped the leaves from the trees.
He stripped off his wet clothes.
Thieves stripped the car of its parts.
They stripped the walls before painting.
examples.ar: هم نزعوا ورق الجدران قبل الطلاء.

examples.en: The court stripped him of his title.
The doctor asked him to strip to the waist.
examples.ar: الطبيب طلب منه أن ينزع ملابسه حتى الخصر.

examples.en: The team was stripped of its medal.
She stripped the bark from the branch.
